description: This file defines a React hook (`useProgressiveExpand`) and a utility function (`createProgressiveExpandController`) for performing batch processing tasks in a web UI. It enables progressive, non-blocking work execution using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, managing progress and cancellation. The code is used for expanding tree nodes or similar UI elements in batches without blocking the main thread.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to manage progressive batch processing of items, applying work in batches while yielding control back to the browser using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback. Supports start and cancel operations, progress callbacks, and adaptive batching based on total item count.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: Custom React hook that wraps around createProgressiveExpandController, managing UI state (running, progress, counts) and exposing methods to start processing from a list of items or cancel ongoing processing. It orchestrates batch processing for UI responsiveness.
